text:
Alice: Quick sync — customers asking for a reserve->commit path for marketplace private offers. Proposal: allow short-term retainer credits (3-mo) that convert to committed spend at renewal with a retention kicker. Want to align with sales motion + marketplace private-offer mechanics. Thoughts?

Ben: Sounds promising. Key Q: how big should the retainer be to meaningfully de-risk capacity? Also need discount tiers for conversion.

Devon: From finance POV, a retainer of ~10-15% of expected commit for 3 months reduces churn risk. Example: expected commit $500k, retainer $50k. We'll need clear accounting rules (defer vs recognize) and refund policy.

Clara: Legal flag — marketplace private offers have vendor acceptance windows and SKU constraints. We should avoid refundable credits that violate marketplace terms. Need to see specific offer language before committing.

Evan: For rollout, propose pilot with 2 SIs and 3 customers. Staged cadence: pilot announcement -> private offer setup -> convert to commit at month 3 with auto-renew opt-in. We should add canary for onboarding friction.

Gina: From SI perspective, retention kicker should be a co-sell rebate (additional 5%) that vests on renewal. That aligns SI incentives to drive consumption.

Ben: Also think about messaging: don't call it 'refund' — call it 'retainer credit' and document conversion terms clearly.

Alice: Agreed. Action items: Devon to draft finance thresholds + sample calc, Clara to review marketplace T&C, Evan to draft pilot timeline, Gina/Ben to pick pilot customers. I'll schedule a 30m sync Wed.
